project_name: DataOne / Logix Realty Frankfort Data Center Campus
developer: Logix Realty LLC / Logistix Realty; intended user DataOne
status_detail: Clinton County Area Plan Commission gave a favorable recommendation on January 6, 2026 for rezoning about 714.55 acres in Washington and Union townships from agricultural to light industrial for a multi-billion-dollar data center campus with DataOne as intended user. On January 20, 2026, Clinton County Commissioners unanimously denied the 714.55-acre rezoning request, placing a 12-month hold on reconsideration. Separate City of Frankfort materials/reporting indicate DataOne later expressed renewed interest in already-zoned city industrial park land, but no formal city commitment was confirmed.
notes: County official site was visited for local government identity/meetings. Project acreage and county denial are from local reporting; city mayor statement is official but addresses only potential renewed interest and required transparency/impact studies.
